authorization: Root separately approved the exact1920-request negative investigation after both positive-advance branches closed. Their failures remain retained, with no new prompt/model/context/seed search.
question: Can exact symbolic dependency preservation support a useful model-specific harm gate on fresh mixed record graphs, and where do semantic correctness, actual model answers, fixed-output routing ceilings and complete costs diverge?
classification: Candidate-mechanism negative/engineering investigation; substantive value assessed from actual results, no guaranteed publication worth or novelty.

primary_tests.falsifier: At least one full-correct/slice-wrong native response with independently checked semantic closure on fresh confirmation tables refutes universal preservation of these model task answers by this certificate. Zero observed harm is not a guarantee.
primary_tests.denominator: Every offered request, with all four correctness classes, separately by pair and family.

primary_tests.definition: Within each repeat independently, a request is oracle-correct iff that repeat full OR slice native output is exact. Never combine outputs across repeats opportunistically. A second conservative ceiling uses (full correct in all repeats) OR (slice correct in all repeats).
primary_tests.falsifier: If a ceiling is below95%, no selector limited to those observed outputs can meet95% on that defined population/repetition. This does not rule out other outputs, prompts, checkpoints or learning methods. If it is at least95%, routing remains sufficient in principle; no impossibility claim.

primary_tests.definition: Actual product depth-two harmful-omission Gini training, separate calibration grid0,.05,.1,.25,.5,1. At least8 accepted, zero observed calibration harm,95% routed calibration accuracy and positive request savings; otherwise ALWAYS_FULL. All-repetition conservative labels, all four classes retained.
primary_tests.falsifier: ALWAYS_FULL refusal is this fixed calibration outcome. Matching simple/alwaysslice gives no learned advantage. Failure on confirmation remains failure. No trained-LLM or population guarantee.

primary_tests.definition: On exactly the32 fit tables, compare actual dependency-slice responses with actual matched-budget-slice responses; each policy has its own same-size full baseline and two balanced pairs. Match record counts, disclose actual token differences, unchanged fixed output caps. No result-driven selection.
primary_tests.falsifier: No better actual correctness/harm behavior than matched shortening weakens the practical claim that exact dependency selection matters here. A symbolic answer difference in the deliberately nonsemantic control is expected and disclosed. Development only, not protected confirmation.

descriptive_strata.scope: Marginal descriptive strata only, no outcome-selected bins, significance or independent-repetition assumptions.

freezes: Exact fit/calibration/control recipes and native training protocol before native labels.

Seeds/generator/counts above frozen before confirmation generation. Freeze actual fitted controller, then construct all three exact confirmation recipes (recording first population generation/access), then freeze their hashes before any native confirmation or outcome access. Generation is necessary to compute exact recipes and cannot adapt any parameter.
quality_and_cost: Existing95% absolute quality for both arms, zero aggregate pair regression, original5% full-wall improvement/10% tail rules remain unchanged. Every actual request remains offered work. Ineligible timing is descriptive; no positive speedup rescue. Request-cost calibration excludes preparation and is not full-cost evidence. All failed attempts, retries if any, setup/build/search/analysis/training costs remain recorded with overlapping scopes separated.

budget.fit_timing_rule: After first completed fit study, project all remaining phase requests at its enclosing product-execution seconds/request multiplied by1.5. Stop before additional native studies if this projection plus actual native execution exceeds10800 seconds or remaining original deadline. No replacement matrix or setting search from outcomes.

claim_limits: Substantial prior-art overlap; no new architecture, Qwen training, population-risk guarantee, general language compression claim or publication-ready promise. Fixed-output ceilings are conditional and repetitions share tables.

supersedes_before_execution.reason: Clarify that exact recipe construction may generate and hash the already-frozen confirmation population; all three recipes must precede native confirmation/outcome access. No population or criterion changes.
